newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle up $0.50-$1.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle up $0.50-$1.00 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were $0.50-$1.00 per cwt higher, compared to Monday's close, USDA said. Trade was moderate and demand moderate to strong. Seller interest moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 63.00-63.50. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 63.00-63.50.
On a carcass basis (weight only) compared Monday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were mostly $1.00 higher.
